scope: Artifact retention and matching build-product reuse only; no production work, phase execution or validation campaign.

minimum_sufficient_validation.integration: The owner-accepted Minimum Sufficient Validation addendum incorporates these A/B/C roles, tracking/runtime-dependency preflight and selective cleanup after successful owner-approved publication. The original proposal, explicit technical gates, applicable thresholds and immutable history remain unchanged. An unapplied review patch has no activation effect.

one_time_exception.historical_results: Intentional removal of reproducible binaries does not invalidate historical PASS or relabel historical FAIL/incomplete results. Preserve all records and recorded original identities.
one_time_exception.tracked_outputs: Historical consumed exception: 86 tracked runtime DLL worktree copies were deleted, preserving their Git objects, index and history. This broke later Post-Build staging. Owner-authorized recovery restored all 86 exact approved HEAD copies; no repeat authorization or automatic deletion of tracked prerequisites follows.

trigger: Only after explicit owner APPROVE PRE_EDITOR PHASE XX for 18-55 and successful guarded finish with verified branch/tag publication and COMPLETE. Nothing between seal and finish.

selective_cleanup.remove: Only untracked generated EXE/PDB, temporary binaries and Candidate/Diagnostic outputs in the completed phase declared scope that are obsolete, unreferenced, reproducible, unused and safe; never prerequisites, canonical/required products or evidence.
preserve: Every Git-tracked path, especially runtime DLL prerequisites and staging sources under either bin root; Git recoverability does not authorize deletion
Current canonical Debug/Release application and engine outputs
Binaries and runtime/build dependencies needed by the next active phase
Necessary acceptance artifacts and dependencies still required by active or next-phase builds/runtime
Immutable checkpoint metadata, source/raw/index objects, validation records, hashes and failure evidence
Artifacts whose actual continued presence is required by active build/input/acceptance contracts or applicable retention records
Unrelated owner work and all uncertain items
forbidden: Automatic deletion of Git-tracked runtime prerequisites or other tracked paths, regardless of location or reproducibility
Automatic full-bin deletion or deletion of either root
Source, bin-int/, runtime/, logs/, docs/, external-dependency or Git/index/ref/tag mutation by cleanup
Changing integrity/publication guards, refreshing historical evidence, resealing, or standalone SEAL
Rebuild, application launch or historical requalification solely for cleanup

lightweight_operation: Use the current phase's declared artifact roles, dependency/reuse closure and output inventory; do not reconstruct historical campaigns.

Before deletion, dry-run exact Git tracking and active/next-phase runtime/build staging dependencies, including staging sources under bin; exclude every tracked or required path. Check ownership, containment, reparse points, hardlinks and current use. Never follow links outside authorized roots.

Preserve uncertain/in-use artifacts. Delete only untracked, verified obsolete generated outputs using literal contained paths; verify retained required identities. Missing prerequisites are a build-repair issue, not permission to delete more files.
Idempotent: absent obsolete outputs require no action. A cleanup failure or skip is reported as housekeeping and cannot reverse, block or rerun a successful publication.
Do not interpret nonblocking housekeeping as permission to weaken a technical gate or delete required/uncertain evidence.
reuse: Prefer matching existing products when relevant sources, generated inputs, dependency/toolchain identities, build flags, configuration and assets/settings match.
Keep original tested-binary identities and old evidence immutable. A new/rebuilt product is not previously tested merely because its source matches.
Keep derived-output retention roles separate from immutable evidence and consumed inputs; never shrink or refresh an existing seal.
unchanged: Sealed Phase17 governance, receipts, publication journal, approved commit/tag and original proposal
Existing checkpoint helper and every integrity/publication guard
All phase technical gates and owner-controlled broader governance activation

artifact_classes.A_tracked_runtime_prerequisites: NEVER delete automatically. Tracked DLLs and staging sources under bin are repository-managed prerequisites, not disposable generated outputs. Git recoverability is not permission to delete them.
artifact_classes.B_disposable_generated_outputs: Untracked generated EXE/PDB, temporary binaries and obsolete Candidate/Diagnostic outputs MAY be deleted only when proven reproducible, obsolete, unreferenced, unused and safe.
artifact_classes.C_required_products_and_evidence: Preserve current canonical Debug/Release outputs, active/next-phase binaries and runtime/build dependencies, necessary acceptance artifacts and immutable checkpoint/validation evidence.
